nodes.title: SG-10.2.1 Focused-object id field and setter in the game store
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts exports useGameStore with state, setState and init only. Desired behavior: add a focusedObjectId field (string or null) and a setFocusedObject action so keyboard focus can later be pushed into the scene. Expected result: both exist on the real store and are unit tested. Why: SG-10.2 needs a shared focus source of truth without duplicating state in Phaser or React.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fresh store, when focusedObjectId is read, then it is null
- Given a fresh store, when setFocusedObject('bookshelf') is called, then focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf'
- Given a focused object, when setFocusedObject(null) is called, then focusedObjectId is null
- Given the existing store tests, when run, then init and setState behavior is unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: focusedObjectId field
- In scope: setFocusedObject action
- In scope: unit tests for both
- Out of scope: BootScene wiring
- Out of scope: keyboard handler changes
- Out of scope: UI rendering of focus
- Preserve: state, setState and init behavior
- Preserve: existing gameStore tests


## Technical constraints
- Use the existing zustand store in game/frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts
- Tests import the real store, not a mock


## Definition of done
- Field and action implemented
- Unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Game store exposes focusedObjectId defaulting to null
nodes.body:
Context: GameStoreState has no focus field. Desired behavior: GameStoreState declares focusedObjectId: string | null and the store initializes it to null. Expected result: reading it on a fresh store returns null and init/setState do not alter it. Why: gives consumers a defined focus value before any key press.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fresh store, when focusedObjectId is read, then it is null
- Given init is called with a GameState, when focusedObjectId is read, then it is still null


## Scope
- In scope: focusedObjectId field and default
- Out of scope: setter action
- Out of scope: scene wiring
- Preserve: state, setState, init


## Technical constraints
- Type is string | null


## Definition of done
- Field typed and defaulted to null


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · setFocusedObject sets and clears the focused object id
nodes.body:
Context: no action writes focus. Desired behavior: setFocusedObject(id: string | null) sets focusedObjectId to id without touching state. Expected result: store reflects the id passed, including null. Why: the keyboard handler and scene need one write path.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fresh store, when setFocusedObject('bookshelf') is called, then focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf'
- Given focus is 'bookshelf', when setFocusedObject(null) is called, then focusedObjectId is null
- Given an initialized state, when setFocusedObject('door') is called, then state is the same object as before


## Scope
- In scope: setFocusedObject action
- Out of scope: validating the id against scene objects
- Out of scope: scene wiring
- Preserve: state, setState, init


## Technical constraints
- Action uses zustand set with a partial update


## Dependencies
- REQ-1 field


## Definition of done
- Action implemented and typed


## Clarifying questions
- None
